validation_stage: Final source and PDF checks before generating the distribution manifest.

ordered_tests.scope: Finite graph/matrix operations, source-free closure, full positive-pivot and top-tree oracles, cloned-Rado oracle, independent positive/negative replay, certificate mutations, exact large-integer and resource checks.

output_tests.scope: Factorial-free output assignment kernel, independent full positive-pivot and top-tree oracles, producer-disabled positive and complete-negative replay, mutation and parity/resource controls.

pdf.visual_result: Readable text, figures, tables, equations and bibliography; no observed clipping or overlap.

scope: Finite algorithm and artifact validation; no claim of formal proof verification or a global quasi-polynomial unknot recognizer.
